name: cosmos-knowledge-tools
description: Source-grounded LLM wiki maintenance and auditable raw-source conversion for Cosmos.

interface.shortDescription: Build a source-grounded LLM wiki and convert raw sources.
interface.longDescription: Packages two Cosmos workflows: llm-wiki, which builds, queries, lints, and maintains a structured, source-grounded wiki of Markdown pages inside an Obsidian vault without calling any LLM API of its own, and raw-to-markdown, which converts files under raw/ into auditable Markdown sidecars through a pinned engine. Both run local code only; neither contacts the network. Obsidian-specific authoring skills and web extraction are installed separately from the official kepano/obsidian-skills collection.
defaultPrompt: Help me manage my Cosmos knowledge base.
